4. Device Array Groups and Relay/Annunciator Tags

In this workbook, “Device Array” means the right-hand additional-equipment parameter section, not automatically a mathematical array. Group rows by Device Name. A Device Name entered on the first row applies to following rows until the next nonblank Device Name, unless the workbook owner specifies otherwise.

The workbook shows Data Count 124, while the address list contains entries extending beyond the first 124 parameter rows depending on how the column is interpreted. The engineering team must define whether Data Count means Modbus registers per request, tags/parameters in the map, or a vendor-specific setting. The software must not blindly use 124 as a read length.

The workbook visibly supplies parameter labels and addresses, but not all decoding details. Data type, signedness, register type, byte/word order, scale, offset, unit, bit location and polling interval must come from an approved manufacturer/model profile or explicit engineering input.
